* Fiery Death reads huge in PoB and does almost nothing in a boss fight. It only explodes enemies you ignite — your minions are physical/cold, so it never triggers. Same trap: Minion Instability.

▸ Tiers: a range on a chip (Bleed I–III, Brutality I–III, Feeding Frenzy I/II) means any of those tiers works — use the highest you have; all tiers cost the same attributes. Lower tiers are a few % weaker (Bleed I–II −2–3%, Brutality I −4%); PoB can't see what Feeding Frenzy II or Brutality III add. Two higher tiers do a different job: Bleed IV — melee minions hit bleeding enemies harder, but it can't cause bleeding, so don't use it on the Spectre, Sniper or Detonate Dead (chips marked “not IV”; −11% / −18% / −15%). Rapid Casting III — speeds up per different spell cast recently; it beats Rapid Casting II, and is Detonate Dead's best 5th support if you cast 3+ different spells. There is no Bleed V.

▸ Worth an attribute node: Int picks beyond the core 14 need 1 attribute node switched Str→Int each (≈1.2% EHP, −1 Spirit). Best value: Detonate Dead's Concentrated Area (≈ +8% total damage) and Pain Offering's two supports (+13% army damage) — 3 nodes, 17 Spirit still spare.

▸ Discipline comes from a level 19 Uncut Spirit Gem (character level 84+). It gives you and your minions in your Presence flat Energy Shield (309 at gem level 19, 328 at 20; PoB: +18% EHP for you). Two unknowns: its Spirit cost (PoB has none — you have 20 spare) and its attribute requirement (PoB: 13 Str / 29 Int at level 19; the wiki says up to 58 Str / 149 Int — your Int is 72). Check both on the gem before cutting it.

▸ Gem rules: Support gems have NO level — they use tiers (I/II/III) set when you engrave them. Only active & spirit gems have levels, raised by consuming an Uncut Skill Gem of that level or higher (gems never gain XP). Vendors do not sell gems. Uncut gem level = area level, so farm the highest zone you can clear; side bosses (coloured skull icons) are the best campaign source. Moving a support between skills is free.

▸ Buy order on a budget: ① Sceptre (Spirit% + minion levels) ② Amulet (+minion levels, +Spirit) ③ Body (+Spirit) ④ chaos res spread across helmet/gloves/belt/rings ⑤ boots last. Buy one strong affix per item — dual-stat rares cost far more than the sum of their parts.
▸ While levelling: the roll ranges are endgame ceilings — low item-level gear rolls the same stats lower, so take them anyway. Until your 40s: Spirit & minion levels → Life (and Str) → resistances. ES only climbs to the top after the tree's ES block (~pt 49) and Beidat's Hand (~Lv 70). +Spirit stops mattering once your army fits.
rot:
Mapping — 2 buttons
  1. Pain Offering
  2. Detonate Dead on corpse piles
  3. Walk behind the army
Bossing — 3 buttons
  1. Pain Offering
  2. Brute command Shattering Roar (Intimidate: +10%)
  3. Detonate Dead

Optional 4th: Vulnerability (+6%) — or Despair if the boss resists physical.

▸ What each button is worth (measured, total damage): Pain Offering +36% · Detonate Dead 33% of all your damage · Shattering Roar +10% · Vulnerability +6% · Unearth 7% raw, but it eats the corpses Detonate Dead needs · Gas Arrow (Sniper command) ~1% · Ice Armour (Frost Mage command) defence only. 3 buttons keep ≈ 87% of full damage; 4 keep ≈ 92%. Skip Unearth, Gas Arrow and Ice Armour (use Ice Armour only if your minions keep dying).
▸ Corpse economy: Detonate Dead consumes corpses (Pain Offering doesn't). Dropping Unearth leaves every corpse for Detonate Dead. Corpses come from your own minions dying & reviving, so it is weakest at the START of a boss fight. Sacrifice (Spirit gem) lets living minions count as corpses — the fix for single-target.
Stuck on a boss? ① minions dying → add Skeletal Cleric, or press Ice Armour ② you dying → resistances, then Life; keep your distance ③ boss not dying → raise active gem levels, press Shattering Roar, then a better spectre ④ still stuck → go get Ascendancy points.
